slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do all three products need to be processed on all three machines in the fixed sequence of Machine 1, then Machine 2, then Machine 3?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether all products follow the fixed machine sequence 1 -> 2 -> 3, directly covering the sequential machine order constraint.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the primary objective of the schedule, such as minimizing the total time to complete all three products
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the primary objective, but did not clarify the ambiguous term 'total processing cycle' or explicitly ask whether it means makespan; it later assumed makespan without confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 'total processing cycle' is equivalent to the makespan, i.e., the time at which the last product finishes processing on Machine 3.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The simulator only repeated that the objective is to minimize the total processing cycle and did not confirm that this means makespan or last completion time; the agent asserted the equivalence itself.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while H2 remained only partially resolved: the objective term 'total processing cycle' was never clarified as makespan or otherwise confirmed.

summary: The agent successfully recovered the fixed machine-sequence constraint, but only partially probed the objective and then silently equated 'total processing cycle' with makespan. It stopped with that P0 objective ambiguity unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
